description: Codex adapters for the shared hooks maintained under .claude/hooks.

hooks.command: bun "$(d=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); while s=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree); do if [ -z "$s" ]; then c=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) && m=$(git -C "$d" --git-dir="$c" rev-parse --show-toplevel) && [ "$m" != "$d" ] && s=$(git -C "$m" rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree) || break; fi; [ -n "$s" ] || break; d=$s; done; printf %s "$d")/.codex/run-shared-hook.ts" .claude/hooks/prompt-router.ts
